method: Claude-written prompt -> design spec (BlenderSource/TownLife09/town11_shapes.py) -> Codex-style soft studio concept render of a throwaway blockout by BlenderSource/TownLife09/concept_render09.py. No AI image model was available in the cloud session; the prompts can be re-run with an image model.

images.name: 01_front.png
images.title: 正面
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender modeling reference for a xianxia (Chinese immortal-cultivation) open-world town, single modular game asset: 石拱橋 (StoneArchBridge). Design: Single-span humpback stone bridge, 8 m span and 2.4 m wide, with a semicircular arch, voussoir ring, paved deck and parapets with lotus-capped posts. Scale: Approx. 9.6 x 2.8 x 2.6 m; deck crown 1.45 m above the ends. Style: softly beveled stylized 3D game art matching the existing dondon town (blue-grey stone paving, warm cedar timber, red lacquer, curved blue-grey tile roofs, restrained jade and gold accents). View: straight front elevation, camera level, facing the -Y front, entire object visible on a light grey seamless studio background with soft contact shadow. No characters, no scenery, no text or lettering, no watermark.
